summary: Fix VM create with large install ISOs failing as a false CPU incompatibility.

guide.reason: Operator create steps are unchanged; only a false failure during create is removed.

api.reason: No Controller/Core API contract changed; placement and create still use the same commands and result shape.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix inside the existing VM create path.

state.reason: No new durable setting; Core still owns VM definitions and media digests.

verification.method: New placement and CPU-compare regressions failed before and passed after. Full internal/vmhost package tests passed. On the disposable lab host, the previously failing multi-GiB ISO create completed as succeeded in about 24s after deploying the fixed Core binary; Controller stayed up with NRestarts=0.
